speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Ahoy there kind stranger! Tell me, are you as full of joy , love, and charity as me today?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: I am full of joy, love. But charity is questinable

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Can I inquire as to why the charity section of your heart id potentially hardened?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: It's not hardened, it is just suspicious of anyone and everyone

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Well, let me ask you this. What do you believe the value of charity is to you?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: It depends on what I am giving to. Am I giving to an organization or straight to another fellow human.

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: I would argue that the recipient is not relevant. You see, in my opinion, Charity in and of itself is a selfish act. Or perhaps, a better way to say it is that it is more of an exchange. We exchange our time, energy, money etc for a powerful thing. That thing is called purpose.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Oh!! That really opened me up. I've never thought of it that way. But that goes against the literal definition of charity, no?

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Perhaps, but does the definition matter to those who are in need?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Not at all. Those in need don't mind where help comes from. But I tend to question some charity organizations. What's your view on these organizations/ foundations?

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Well, I have one in mind specifically. It's called Save The Children. They seem pretty fantastic. Theyve single handedly reduced the infant mortality rate by 62% in third world countries. Can I verify that? Of course not. But I believe it. And thats what matters to me. I believe that the little I have to give could help, and because of that it makes me feel delightful. I'm doing my best with what I've got. Are you?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: You know what they say..."charity begins at home". So I make sure my home is helped before I help others.

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Of course! As you should. I believe your heart it good, I can tell just from talking to you anonymously. But I also believe that there is more of you to share with the world. The world needs it, and I believe you want to feel it. So let me ask you this: The researchers conducting this study are able to use all of your bonus or just some and send it directly to this children's charity. Do you think you are ready to do that?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: I'll pledge $0.50

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: I think thats very admirable of you. Truly kind. It's pleasure talking with you today.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: Pleasure talking to you as well

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Do you feel like you could have given more out of curiosity? And if so, what held you back?

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: No, that's max. The rest is for my home

speaker: AZYUCL6B0YROY
text: Understood. Well, congrats on expanding yourself today, my friend.

speaker: A3EN6WYTR0D2P5
text: You are welcome
